why_best: It transforms complex procedural logic into a live, authoritative event that anchors viewer trust without sacrificing broadcast clarity.
why_bad: Overloading the frame with dramatic camera moves or sudden full-screen reveals destroys the grounded, journalistic objectivity essential for this register.
trap: A weak variation would hurry the output rhythm to save time, sacrificing the realistic cadence of live command execution and making the visual feel like a cheap graphic overlay.
